text:
incident-bot: ALERT — p99 latency breach for customer ClearVault on prod-streaming (us-west1). Threshold 1.5s breached at 2060456788 :rotating_light:

oncall_ryan: I'm paged, taking it. seeing p95 ~380ms, p99 ~5.6s, but streaming tails showing stalls up to 15s. starting Grafana + logs.

sara_prodeng: ClearVault is single-tenant on dedicated pool. They pushed a new ingestion job ~10m ago that concatenates lots of documents into one prompt. many requests now with 6k-9k token prefixes.

marco_infra: KV cache evictions spiking, node mem pressure 92% across dpool-clearvault-1. autoscaler didn't add nodes — hitting sgpu quota for this region.

aj_ops: propose immediate mitigations: 1) temporary request throttling to 200 qps for ClearVault 2) disable streaming responses for that customer 3) route to smaller quantized model (gpt-medium-q4) while we stabilize. any objections?

chris_customer_success: reached out to ClearVault engineering — they approve 50% throughput reduction and disabling streaming for 10–30m. they want us to avoid dropping requests.

leah_sre: applying routing rule now. command:
```
# route override to non-streaming and model fallback
POST /admin/routes/override
{
  "customer_id": "clearvault",
  "route_rules": [
    {"match": "*", "action": "fallback_model", "model": "gpt-medium-q4"},
    {"match": "*", "action": "disable_streaming", "value": true}
  ]
}
```

oncall_ryan: override applied. also set per-customer rate limit to 200 qps via live-config.

marco_infra: after route change p95 ~260ms, p99 ~1.2s, streaming stalls gone. KVCACHE eviction rate dropped ~80%. still seeing some 503s for long concurrent sessions (rare).

aj_ops: leaving a temporary autoscale ticket — quota request submitted to cloud. plan: add 2 GPUs to dedicated pool when approved, and increase KV cache capacity (ttl + size). Also add prompt-length-based routing to prevent huge prefixes hitting the same model instance.

sara_prodeng: root cause summary: unusual long prompts + high concurrency causing KV cache thrash + memory pressure => streaming stalls at tail. Mitigation successful: throttling + disable streaming + model fallback. Follow-ups: (1) prompt-length routing (2) KV cache size/ttl tuning and metrics alert (3) customer guidance on request batching/streaming best practices.

incident-bot: Incident created — #incident-2060456789-clearvault. Assigning for postmortem: oncall_ryan, sara_prodeng, marco_infra, aj_ops. :white_check_mark:

chris_customer_success: clearing with customer — they will run a patched ingestion but want a longer-term change on routing. thanks all.

leah_sre: will open postmortem draft and link runbook items. putting follow-up actions in tech debt board.

oncall_ryan: closing paging for now. will monitor for 30m and then promote to follow-up ticket if stable. :thumbsup:
